CampusNet: An Interactive University Community Platform 

Final Project Report 

Aunindya Prosad Saha (202114014)

September 17, 2025  
I. INTRODUCTION 

CampusNet is an interactive mobile application built using Flutter. The app connects students, alumni and faculty members, creating a unified platform for campus life. It provides essential services such as an AI-powered chatbot, campus navigation map, messaging system and emergency features such as blood donation ambulance services etc. The app aims to help new students connect with their peers and alumni and help them navigate the campus more effectively. 

This application addresses several pain points for students, particularly for freshers, such as finding alumni expertise, navigating the campus and accessing critical services. Through features like profile generation, tuition service opportunities and emergency features, Campus Net aims to provide a seamless experience for both students and alumni. 

II. TARGET USERS 

The app is designed for a wide range of users includ ing: 

*•* Undergraduate Students 

*•* Graduate Students 

*•* Alumni 

III. LITERATURE REVIEW OF EXISTING CAMPUS APPS 

Several universities have developed mobile applica tions to enhance student engagement, streamline admin istrative processes and provide essential campus services. Below is an overview of five such applications: 

1\) Campus.pk 

A comprehensive e-learning platform offering video lectures, MCQ tests, online notes and live sessions for students across Pakistan. It aims to provide flexible learning opportunities and facilitate teacher student interactions. *\[Available on Google Play Store\]*. 

2\) Campus+ by FH Campus Wien 

Designed for students at FH Campus Wien, this app provides access to class schedules, campus card bal ances, cafeteria menus, course overviews and news updates. It serves as a central hub for academic and campus-related information. *\[Available on Google Play Store\]*. 

3\) Campus Student 

A widely used app in the U.S., Campus Student offers real-time access to announcements, assign ments, attendance, grades and schedules. It aims to keep students informed and organized throughout their academic journey. *\[Available on Apple App Store\]*.   
4\) Campus.uno 

This platform provides a comprehensive ERP solu tion for educational institutions, facilitating access to academic information for students, parents and educators. It aims to streamline communication and administrative processes within educational institu tions. *\[Available on Google Play Store\]*. 

5\) Campus+ (UM6P) 

Developed for Mohammed VI Polytechnic Uni versity, this app offers access to campus events, news, class schedules and program information. It aims to enhance the university experience by providing students with relevant information at their fingertips. *\[Available on Apple App Store\]*.

IV. PROBLEM STATEMENT AND IDENTIFICATION Based on the review of existing systems, the primary issues identified are: 

*•* Lack of a unified platform for campus-related ser vices. 

*•* Inadequate connection mechanisms for students and alumni. 

*•* Fragmentation of essential services like campus navigation, emergency services and tuition oppor tunities across different apps. 

*•* Lack of AI-driven support for campus-related ques tions. 

V. OBJECTIVES 

The main objectives of the CampusNet app are: 

*•* To provide instant assistance and campus guidance through an integrated AI chatbot. 

*•* To build a unified platform for communication, emergency services and alumni-student networking. *•* To enhance campus navigation and accessibility with an interactive map. 

1  
VI. FEATURE LIST 

The core features of the app include: 

*•* Chatbot (NetBot): AI-powered assistant for an swering questions and giving campus info. *•* Campus Map: Interactive map to help users navi gate campus buildings, classrooms and auditoriums. *•* Blog Post Feed: Platform for students and clubs to share updates, events and stories. 

*•* Resource Bank: A centralized repository of study materials, including notes, textbooks and other aca demic resources for all courses across departments. 

*•* Tuition Services: A platform to connect tutors and learners. 

*•* Messaging: One-to-one and group messaging with resource sharing. 

*•* Emergency Services: Features to request and do nate blood and contact emergency services like ambulances. 

*•* Profile and CV Generator: A feature to create and share a student’s profile and generate a CV.

IX. ETHICAL CONCERNS 

The app raises several ethical concerns, including: *•* User data (personal, academic) is collected and stored securely with user consent.   
Fig. 6\. Resource Bank feature. 

*•* Location data is used exclusively for campus navi gation with explicit user approval. 

*•* Blood donation and emergency service features require user consent to share contact details. *•* No microphone or camera access is requested unless the user voluntarily uses the voice input feature for the chatbot. 

X. SOCIETAL IMPACTS 

CampusNet can have a significant positive impact: 3  
*•* Helps freshers navigate campus and connect with peers quickly. 

*•* Fosters a sense of community by enabling alumni student mentorship. 

*•* Promotes social responsibility through features like blood donation and tutoring opportunities. *•* Enables students to access and share study materi als/resources effortlessly.
